description: OWASP ZAP: web application security scanner as an API daemon (spider, passive and active scans, reports) for CI pipelines and automation. Hardened by QuenchWorks: CVE-gated, cosign-signed and pinned by digest.

Etherpad: real-time collaborative document editing with plugins, an HTTP API and an admin UI, on the bundled PostgreSQL. Hardened by QuenchWorks: built from source, CVE-gated, cosign-signed and pinned by digest.

PentAGI: autonomous AI agents for penetration testing, running their tools in containers through a Docker API sidecar, on the bundled PostgreSQL with pgvector. Hardened by QuenchWorks: built from source, CVE-gated, cosign-signed and pinned by digest.
